skills.name: River's Breath (川息/川の息吹)
skills.line: In the name of Arakawa, I'm Lord Arakawa!
skills.description: SP Lord Arakawa forms water to a torrent to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

skills.name: River's Fury (川怒/川の怒り)
skills.line: The strong must be hunted down if they bully the weak!
skills.description:
When SP Lord Arakawa is KO'd, his body becomes Unflinching until the end of battle.
Exclusive effect. When an ally receives over 30% of their max HP as damage, his move bar is increased by 50% and 1 control effect is removed from him. Only triggers once each turn. ;Upon Usage :Gains a Sea Fury stack. All allies gain the damage reduction effects of Unflinching. Sustained for 1 turn. ;Unflinching (不動の守護) : :'''General, Mark''': Prevents SP Lord Arakawa from being revived or have his spot taken. Reduces the damage taken for all allies by 10%, for every 300 of their initial ATK he has grants an additional 1% of damage reduction, up to a max of 30%. He continues to exist as a soul upon being KO'd. On his turn, he harnesses Sea Waves to attack all enemies dealing damage equal to 20% of the total initial ATK of all ally shikigami (total ATK cannot exceed 120% of his initial ATK). This is an exclusive effect and the damage from Sea Waves doesn't trigger his or the enemies' soul effects. ;Sea Fury (海の怒り) : : '''Buff, Mark''': Each stack increases damage dealt by 20% and SPD by 30. Max 3 stacks.

upgrades.text: Damage for Sea Waves increases to 22% of all allies' initial ATK.
Effects of Sea Fury won't disappeared after he is KO'd.
When KO'd, restores the HP of all allies by 125% of his own HP.
Damage multiplier for each strike of Sea Waves is equal to 120% of the last strike (damage can be increased a max of 5 times).

skills.name: Wavebreaker Slash (驍浪海作斬/海の驍浪を刃に)
skills.description: SP Lord Arakawa cleaves through the water and strikes an enemy with a towering wave, dealing damage equal to 287% of his ATK. If the target is KO'd, he loses 1 layer of Sea Fury.

upgrades.text: Target is regarded as being inflicted with Isolation.

When he has 3 layers of Sea Fury, his DEF is decreased by 20% and his damage dealt is increased by 40%, after using this skill all allies gain the damage reduction effects of Unflinching (sustained for 1 turn).

bio.condition: With SP Lord Arakawa clear any zone 30 times.
Increase SP Lord Arakawa's level to 40.
Increase SP Lord Arakawa's skill 8 times.
